venues.name: WICC
description: The WICC (Windhoek International Convention Centre) is built for larger conferences, exhibitions and trade shows, with adaptable event floors capable of hosting keynote sessions, breakout meetings and exhibition stands under one roof.
Its central Windhoek location and dedicated event infrastructure make it a natural fit for organisations hosting multi-day conferences or large-scale corporate gatherings.

venues.name: Windhoek Country Club Resort & Casino
description: Windhoek Country Club Resort & Casino combines resort-style grounds with dedicated conference facilities, making it well suited to residential conferences, incentive programmes and corporate golf days.
Delegates can move easily between meeting space, dining venues and the resort's leisure facilities, giving organisers flexibility when building an agenda that blends business with downtime.

venues.name: Movenpick
description: Movenpick offers a polished hotel setting suited to corporate meetings, small conferences and incentive groups travelling through Namibia. Guests have access to well-appointed function space, on-site dining and outdoor areas that make for relaxed networking breaks between sessions.
Its combination of comfortable accommodation and flexible event space makes it a dependable choice for organisations looking to pair business sessions with a high standard of hospitality.

venues.name: The Westin Cape Town
description: The Westin Cape Town provides well-appointed conference facilities in a full-service hotel setting, suited to corporate meetings, conferences and incentive groups travelling into South Africa.
With on-site dining, a spa and comfortable accommodation alongside its event space, it offers a convenient single-venue solution for multi-day business events.
